_comment: Docs legacy-ref allowlist gate (t174). The gate scans docs/**/*.md + core/templates/*.md + each harness/<h>/skills/aidlc/SKILL.md (derived FROM DISK) and FAILS unless every surviving retired-token line is pinned here by exact file + line text, with the pinned count <= ceiling. FOUR retired-token lanes: (1) `aidlc-docs` — the flat record layout relocated to aidlc/spaces/<space>/intents/<slug>-<id8>/; (2) bare `--init` — the retired aidlc command; (3) dotted rules dirs `.claude/rules/` | `.kiro/steering/` | `.codex/aidlc-rules/` — the method/rules layer relocated to aidlc/spaces/<space>/memory/ (graph.ts MEMORY_SEGMENTS), so these survive ONLY in native-include prose (the `.claude/rules/aidlc.md` @-import stub, Kiro IDE's `.kiro/steering/aidlc-active-memory.md`, the packager rename narrative); (4) `*-learnings.md` filename — learnings collapsed into practices in memory/{team,project}.md (aidlc-learnings.ts), so there are ZERO legitimate survivors. EXCLUDES dist/** (generated; package.ts --check proves parity) and core/aidlc-common/** (the engine-parsed stage tree's aidlc-docs reroot is a separate deferred sweep). Adding an entry requires a visible diff here; blanket-allowlisting trips the ceiling. See docs/reference/07-sensor-system.md, docs/reference/14-claude-features.md, docs/harness-engineering/06-sensors.md.

allowed.text: Claude and Codex consume `hookSpecificOutput.updatedInput`; the opencode adapter applies that rewrite to `output.args`. The hook serializes the complete response before writing and refuses an oversized response with repair guidance, so a transport ceiling cannot turn it into truncated JSON. Kiro CLI exposes subagent arguments but has no rewrite channel, so its adapter observes the proposed rewrite and emits an advisory warning while allowing dispatch; its agent-v1 `resources` preload the memory tree. A valid bundle that exceeds the rewrite limit also proceeds through that native preload, while a missing, unreadable, or invalid UTF-8 required rule still blocks with repair guidance. Kiro IDE does not register this hook because tool-argument delivery is not uniform across supported generations; `.kiro/steering/aidlc-active-memory.md` is always included and uses live file references to preload the active memory tree for the conductor and delegated agents.
